entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of the history of threats to world peace
entries.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an understanding of the history of the great wars of the 17th to 19th Century
entries.learning_activity: Analyse the great wars fought from the 17th to the 19th Century and their impacts on world peace and security (30 Years War, Napoleonic war, and Franco-Prussian war)
teaching_learning_activities: Jigsaw: Divide students into manageable groups and assign each group to explore from different sources the great wars that happened from the 17th to 19th Century and their impacts on world peace and security. Let each group focus on either the 30 Years War, or Napoleonic war, or Franco-Prussian War. Let each group present the findings in a class for discussion
entries.assessment: The great wars fought from the 17th to the 19th Century and their impacts on world peace and security are well analysed
resources: Written texts about the great wars from 17th to 19th Century
entries.references: TIE, History for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Six: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education
